_about: Markets for the Biosimilar Net Cost Recovery calculator (tools/ncr-calculator/). Maintained by hand.
This file holds NO payment limits, product lists or package sizes. scripts/build_site.py takes:
- products: the verified rows of the biosimilar_groups sheet for the market's molecule,
one product per HCPCS code and CMS crosswalk drug name;
- packages: billing units per package from the latest CMS NDC-HCPCS crosswalk;
- payment limits and billing units: the latest CMS payment limit file.
Each market here gives only what CMS files do not: the default dose (from the FDA label named in
dose_source; visitors can change it), which packages to use (only_units, in billing units), which
packages are multi-dose vials (everything else is single-dose), and made-up example contract
terms filled in only when a visitor clicks "Load example prices" (not real contracts).
dose.basis is "per kg", "per m2" or "flat"; the dose is in the market's billing-unit measure
(mg, mcg or units). example_prices are keyed by product name, then package amount in that measure.
